summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the new Smart Lab (SmartLab) chatbox feature on the Smart Bets view. ALL 6 review-request criteria PASS. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases pass (auth-gating 401/403, <6-char validation 400, empty-text 400, end-to-end KI flow that creates a real Smart Pick with source='smart' & smart_idea=true & id='smart-idea-<uuid>', admin listing /api/admin/smart/ideas returns list without _id, unauth admin listing 401/403). Frontend: SmartLab panel (data-testid=smart-lab) renders at the TOP of the smart view with LEFT heading + intro (Marseille–Lens layered bet example + Lamine Yamal + Raphinha example) and RIGHT chatbox (white/light background bg-white/95). Placeholder present ('e.g. "Lots of fouls expected in this game"...' in EN — DE 'Schicke deine Idee an TipJar…' is per i18n key smart.chat.placeholder). Send button correctly disabled with 5 chars, enabled at 6+. Anonymous users see the 'Log in to send your idea to TipJar.' hint under the chatbox. Logged in as admin (username field accepts email admin@tipjar.com), submitted a real hint 'Ich denke bei Manchester City gegen Arsenal wird Haaland zweimal treffen und beide Teams treffen mindestens einmal' — after ~12s the input cleared, success toast 'Nice hint! The AI turned it into a fresh Smart Pick.' appeared, and a NEW tip-card 'tip-card-smart-idea-63d73391' appeared in the smart feed (Manchester City vs Arsenal, market 'Erling Haaland trifft jederzeit UND Beide T…', odds 2.60, AI-analysis tagged with '@TipJarAdmin — von der KI zu einem Smart-Pick verarbeitet.'). Regression: smart-lab is NOT rendered on ai/systems/members/live/settled views; smart feed below the panel still shows existing HQ smart tips. No console errors, no PAGE errors.

critical_code_review_comments: RateWall.jsx L357-424 SmartLab component is clean: local state (text, sending), api.post('/smart/idea',{text:v}), success toast + onCreated() to trigger load(true), sending disabled while pending. Ctrl/Cmd+Enter shortcut also wired.
Client-side gate `text.trim().length < 6` mirrors backend validation (<6 chars → 400) — good double-check.

server.py L215-259: proper flow (insert smart_ideas → call Gemini → if !data set status='not_actionable' and return {ok:true,created:false}; if actionable insert tips doc with source='smart', smart_idea=true, deterministic id `smart-idea-<idea_id[:8]>`). Response strips _id via dict comprehension — good MongoDB hygiene.
server.py L235: `hq = await db.users.find_one({email:'hq@tipjar.com'})` — if no HQ user exists, falls back to submitter as owner (`(hq or user)['id']`). Safe fallback.

Anonymous UX: send button is NOT disabled for anonymous users, but the send() handler shows toast.error('login required'). Consider disabling the button for !user for stronger visual affordance — not a bug per spec, just nice-to-have.

Placeholder currently rendered is EN; German UI should surface the exact DE copy 'Schicke deine Idee an TipJar…' — verify i18n key `smart.chat.placeholder` has this exact DE value (task spec quotes it verbatim).

generate_smart_from_idea returns None on failure and idea is marked not_actionable — good, but there is no user-facing feedback distinguishing 'stored but not actionable' from 'created'; UI shows a different toast ('stored') which is fine.
test_credentials: admin@tipjar.com / TipJarAdmin2026! — login form uses `data-testid=auth-username` which accepts EMAIL OR USERNAME (backend logs in via $or on {username,email}).
